texts.zh: 近来在深陷泥潭的[Root.Target.GetName]殖民地上发生了一起重大事件。尽管关键国有设施均安然无恙，但这场有组织的恐怖袭击仍造成了难以估量的财产损失以及人员伤亡，深深地动摇了殖民地稳定的根基。
texts.en: A major incident has occurred on the badly-troubled colony of [Root.Target.GetName]. While state-critical facilities remain unscathed, extensive property damage and significant loss of life as a result of coordinated terrorist attacks have shaken the colony to its core.
